correctness.rationale: The one-extra-label anchored CW space is one-dimensional. Its zero-cells are surjections, vn!/2 in number, and its one-cells are oriented underlying edges with one moving label and an anchored stationary bijection, en! in number. A spanning-tree leaf-fixing algorithm proves connectedness; hence H1 is free with the claimed rank. Its S_n chain modules have exact stabilizers S2 on zero-cells and identity on one-cells. The rational exact sequence yields the induced-module decomposition. Integral edge-orbit sums have boundary exactly twice the underlying graph incidence, so fixed H1 is the ordinary graph cycle lattice and its quotient pushforward is n! times the identity. Any graph loop lifts by letting one extra label travel around it, proving surjectivity without invariants. The packaged standalone checker independently exhausts all cells and all label permutations for six test graphs and verifies the orbit-boundary identity.

value.rationale: The anchored graph space has a natural logistics/reconfiguration meaning. In its first nontrivial excess-particle regime the result provides all rational label-symmetry irreducibles for every connected cyclic network, not merely Betti numbers. It distinguishes invariant integral cycles from homology of the natural unlabelled quotient by an exact factorial-index law in every independent cycle. This mathematically motivated all-graphs structural invariant measures the failure of integral invariants to commute with orbit homology and gives a concrete boundary for equivariant generalizations.
